title: FBI-UAP-D002, FD-1057, Unresolved UAP Report, Colorado Springs, 2022
doc_notes: This is an FBI FD-1057 forensic sketch interview document regarding a UAP observation, and it contains one encounter report.

encounters.summary: A former U.S. Army intelligence officer and four unit members observed a potato-shaped, opalescent UAP with shifting, scale-like panels over the Cheyenne Mountains.
encounters.quote: The object was potato shaped with distinct edges and appeared to look painted in a creamy/whitish opalescent color.
